title: The golden 2028 depreciation uses current-year beginning PP&E, while 2026 and 2027 use the prior column's PP&E, so a consistently built model cannot match G33.
evidence: Golden E33=8.1305=E17*D15 (0.115*70.7) and F33=8.808=F17*E15 (0.12*73.4), but G33=9.29129=G17*G15 (0.12*77.427). The consistent prior-year value G17*F15=9.1375 differs by about 1.7%, which is beyond the 1% tolerance.
